outgoing_mail_finished_ck.value: "outgoing_mail"."status" = 'rejected' or ("outgoing_mail"."status" in ('pending', 'sending') and "outgoing_mail"."finished_at" is null) or ("outgoing_mail"."status" in ('sent', 'unknown', 'expired', 'cancelled') and "outgoing_mail"."finished_at" is not null)
